600.summary: The class explores the role of angels in guiding and protecting humans, emphasizing their constant presence and influence in our lives. It focuses on passages from Genesis and Psalms, highlighting the angels' involvement in creation and their ongoing work to help humans develop godly character.

601.summary: The class discusses the role of angels in Abraham's life, focusing on their interactions and the divine promises made to Abraham and Sarah. It highlights the angels' ability to know human thoughts and their involvement in divine judgments, such as the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.

602.summary: The class discusses the role of angels in the lives of biblical figures like David and Moses, emphasizing their unseen work in guiding and protecting believers. It highlights the importance of living by faith and cooperating with divine guidance, even in challenging circumstances.

603.summary: The class explores the role of angels in the Bible, emphasizing their presence and influence in the lives of believers. It covers passages from Job, Daniel, and Revelation, highlighting the angels' involvement in divine plans and the assurance of God's sovereignty even in difficult circumstances.

604.summary: The class explores the role of angels in the life of Jesus Christ, emphasizing their joy at his birth and their involvement in his mission. It highlights Jesus' unique sacrifice and the importance of faith and salvation through his atonement.
